title: Count Substrings with Only One Distinct Letter
description: Given a string `s`, return *the number of substrings that have only **one distinct** letter*.

examples.explanation:
The substrings with one distinct letter are "aaa", "aa", "a", "b".
"aaa" occurs 1 time.
"aa" occurs 2 times.
"a" occurs 4 times.
"b" occurs 1 time.
So the answer is 1 + 2 + 4 + 1 = 8.

constraints: s[i] consists of only lowercase English letters.
